title: Not Very Sturdy
text: Not Very Sturdy. I guess I'm always the critic. I grew up with Pyrex. These bowls are shaped like the little Pyrex custard bowls except they are pretty thin and not nearly as well made.  I will have to figure out a way to keep them separate because the Pyrex could go in the oven and these can't.
